candidates.snippet: Von der Leyen says the EU backed Trump's energy ceasefire, but Russia didn't honor it "for even a single minute," escalating its aggression instead, meaning no sanctions will be lifted until Russia ends the war. https://t.co/fIpLzGV9io
Moscow airports remained paralyzed as of this morning. https://t.co/Tn1gsqyGPx
Czech PM Andrej Babiš, known for his ambiguous stance on Ukraine, says Trump has essentially betrayed them by making that deal with Putin, adding "we have to do something." https://t.co/d34aIXZDIX
